policy.scope: Only automatic follow with gestures enabled opts into reconnectable sessions.
policy.networkLoss: SSH EOF, attachment heartbeat expiry or output loss detaches the App; supervisor and original worker remain alive.
policy.offlineStopGesture: Fresh confirmed Open_Palm after detachment requests stop and exit, including when the normal gesture gate was already PAUSED.
policy.reconnect: Attach to the original authenticated runId with a fresh token and sequence; never launch another worker.
policy.explicitStop: Accepted stops remain sticky across lost ACK, network loss and App restart; pending App stops are sent first after attach.
policy.noGestures: Uses original bridge and original disconnect stop policy.
policy.connectedBehavior: Existing gesture pause/resume, user stop, page leave, background and focus rules remain.
policy.otherFailures: Local worker lease/status/parent checks and runtime faults still stop. Protocol corruption locks a stop intent; it is not classified as ordinary network loss.
policy.ui: Show detached/unknown or stop-pending status; offer original-session reattach and deferred stop; do not claim remote stop was confirmed.

architecture.workerLease: Existing H/S semantics preserved; opt-in D/C changes only offline gesture policy and does not extend the local lease.
architecture.sessionStorage: .app_follow_sessions (0700); uid-verified local socket (0600); bounded terminal archives without tokens.
architecture.terminalEvidence: Archive final terminal state before sending its ACK; reattaching an exited run cannot restart it.

board.baselineNote: Repository bridge/worker were behind deployed startup/final-status fixes. Synced the captured deployed baseline first; options/lifecycle contents match the prior deployed versions. Other runtime code was not changed.

rollback: While both control owners are idle, restore bridge/worker from initialBackup and remove the new session entry only after no persistent session remains; install saved pre-update APK. Do not replace a running supervisor/worker.
